severity_scope_note: AUD-001 S4 applies to loss in a newly exported runtime Content Package, not destruction of the original supplied ZIP or its persisted imported authority.

findings.category: Runtime Content Package export loses authority metadata
findings.exact_field: custom_fields.vnext_source_refs / course_memberships / source_audio_refs; B1 canonical_unit.examples[].annotations / provenance
findings.reproduction_method: Import the exact nested IMPORT-READY ZIP into the byte-identical v451-R85 runtime; reload; call the production Content Package builder with its default dataset; inspect its TSV; import its output into a second clean origin context; compare protected fields by ID.
findings.expected_behavior: Content Package export must hydrate durable authority before serialization and preserve source/audio/membership lineage and canonical annotations.
findings.actual_behavior: The exported TSV omits all three named top-level custom fields on every card: A1 310, A2 292, B1 395. B1 also omits annotations and provenance from all 1580 canonical_unit example copies. Re-import does not restore them. A2 loses the explicit empty source_audio_refs array; its original audio count remains zero. IDs, counts, primary meanings and separate canonical_examples survive.
findings.root_cause: index.html lines 3423–3445 intentionally compacts CARDS; buildContentPackageV352 lines 12410–12412 serializes CARDS rather than the rich IndexedDB authority. B1 compactCanonicalUnitV425 removes example annotations/provenance. UI exportContentPackageV352 calls this same builder. Original IndexedDB authority remains intact.
findings.existed_before_packaging: YES: runtime code already has this behavior in all supplied archives and CURRENT.
findings.package_introduced_issue: Original release packaging did not corrupt its input content. The subsequent runtime-created Content Package introduces the loss.
findings.current_tests_detect: The new audit detects it. Current lineage_errors catches membership/audio removal when explicitly applied, but is not a native ZIP export integration test; it does not deeply compare B1 annotations. Additional-gates.json records its transport-selector conflicts and its A1 baseline false failures.
findings.previous_tests_should_have_detected: Yes, if acceptance covered this exact behavior; the packaged checks described in section O do not provide that coverage.
findings.earliest_valid_prevention_stage: Runtime integration acceptance after compaction/reload, then Stage6 actual export/re-import gate

findings.category: Example translations absent from learner-facing Study renderer
findings.reproduction_method: Import exact nested ZIP; obtain all active cards; render production Study front/back HTML under the actual app CSS; count German groups, stable example IDs and FA/EN translation nodes. Compare full customFields with compact cards.
findings.expected_behavior: Study renderer must expose the supplied nested example translations through its supported example-language behavior, without converting grouped examples into unilingual text.
findings.actual_behavior: A1 310 cards /1240 groups and B1 395 cards /1580 groups render four DE rows per card but zero FA/EN translation nodes and zero stable example IDs. Model counts alone still equal four. A2 renders 1168 groups with 2336 FA/EN nodes and stable IDs; first three groups are visible and fourth is paginated.
findings.root_cause: A1 rich customFields renders 1240 translated groups, while compact cards render zero because presentation_examples is stripped and the split v411 canonical_examples representation is not adapted into grouped presentation. B1 renders zero even with rich fields: its deep-copy canonical_unit and de/fa/en projection groups do not match the grouped text/translations adapter shape. No CSS hiding explanation is needed: the nodes are absent.
findings.existed_before_packaging: YES: supplied projection/runtime representation interaction predates outer packaging.
findings.package_introduced_issue: NO: unchanged production runtime and imported content reproduce it.
findings.current_tests_detect: Packaged acceptance checks validate data/group counts and selected models without verifying translation-bearing DOM. Audit adds those assertions.
findings.previous_tests_should_have_detected: Yes, if acceptance covered this exact behavior; the packaged checks described in section O do not provide that coverage.
findings.earliest_valid_prevention_stage: Stage5 adapter/presentation closure for each native representation; Stage6 visible rendered translation test

findings.category: Inconsistent third-person singular perfect principal part
findings.reproduction_method: Read the five exact TSV rows and canonical morphology; import and render production Study fronts. Compare finite perfect principal part to the 3sg present/preterite convention.
findings.expected_behavior: A three-part principal-form display uses matching third-person singular values: kostet/kostete/hat gekostet, etc.
findings.root_cause: For these five canonical lexemes, perfect is absent while auxiliary=haben and participle_ii are present. The projection uses auxiliary plus participle without inflecting the auxiliary. Existing slot-presence checks accept the result.
findings.existed_before_packaging: YES: the five strings are already in the exact TSV projection before runtime import.
findings.package_introduced_issue: NO: archived checksums correctly cover the defective projection.
findings.current_tests_detect: Current morphology gate and packaged defect regression check nonempty slots, so they pass. They do not verify finite-form agreement.
findings.previous_tests_should_have_detected: Yes, if acceptance covered this exact behavior; the packaged checks described in section O do not provide that coverage.
findings.earliest_valid_prevention_stage: Stage3 explicit canonical perfect or Stage5 morphology fallback; Stage6 value/convention check

findings.category: Source raw evidence rewritten during normalization
findings.reproduction_method: Hash source screenshots against current SOURCE-MANIFEST; inspect screenshot rows; compare registered transcription to packaged occurrence raw_text by source_order.
findings.expected_behavior: Preserve screenshot-attested raw_text exactly; put enriched present and past forms in normalized/canonical morphology.
findings.root_cause: The Stage1 source adapter reconstructs raw_text from repaired legacy lineage rather than preserving the screenshot transcription. Both correct present and past forms remain in learner-facing canonical morphology; this is an evidence-fidelity issue, not a wrong A2 learner form.
findings.existed_before_packaging: YES: occurrence ledger already contains the replacements before outer packaging.
findings.current_tests_detect: Source/identity/enrichment gates accept a structurally complete VERIFIED occurrence without comparing its raw_text to independently hashed source bytes. All three official gates pass.
findings.previous_tests_should_have_detected: Yes, if acceptance covered this exact behavior; the packaged checks described in section O do not provide that coverage.
findings.earliest_valid_prevention_stage: Stage1 source ingestion; immutable raw-text binding plus explicit normalized_text separation

findings.reproduction_method: Compare notes and German definition on all 395 exact TSV rows; run current prevention_preflight projection gate; render Study details.
findings.expected_behavior: Do not copy generated German definition into a separate generated notes field.
findings.actual_behavior: 395/395 notes duplicate their definition. Current static gate rejects all 395. Runtime suppresses the redundant notes section: zero rendered duplicate notes.
findings.root_cause: Definition was copied into transport notes before packaging; renderer removes equal text from presentation.
findings.current_tests_detect: Current static projection gate detects it; historical visible-note assertions can pass because the renderer suppresses it.
findings.previous_tests_should_have_detected: Yes, if acceptance covered this exact behavior; the packaged checks described in section O do not provide that coverage.
findings.earliest_valid_prevention_stage: Stage5 projection gate before package relock

findings.reproduction_method: Read mb1m-lu-0200 (sich Gedanken machen) related and Synonyme items; compare rendered details and authority export.
findings.expected_behavior: Do not repeat identical synonym display text on a card.
findings.actual_behavior: related contains [nachdenken, nachdenken, nachsinnen], and the Synonyme projection repeats nachdenken. Renderer and authority exporter deduplicate it. Canonical relation records have distinct identities/scopes; no automatic deletion of canonical relations is warranted.
findings.root_cause: Projection flattened two relation records into repeated surface text without deduplicating the display list.
findings.current_tests_detect: Static audit catches it; current generic preflight does not reject duplicate relation surface text.
findings.previous_tests_should_have_detected: Yes, if acceptance covered this exact behavior; the packaged checks described in section O do not provide that coverage.
